summary: Explicit false query values now preserve ordinary order lists; unknown boolean spellings are rejected.
Partly ready or eighty-sixed orders remain in progress until all child items are terminal.
Priority, item status, manual 86 and global availability mutations commit state, audit and parent summaries together; notifications follow commit.
An application factory, isolated database option, JSON error handler and built-in Node test scripts make the real API repeatably testable.
Browser Cancel now cancels 86 actions, and socket effect cleanup clears the pending refresh timer.
Nine detailed learning documents explain actual source, transactions, failure injection, lifecycle rules, request traces and progressive mid-level exercises.

checks.command: npm test --prefix server -- --test-reporter=tap; npm run build --prefix client
checks.environment: Node 22.16.0, npm 10.9.2, locked dependencies, real local HTTP and SQLite memory database; actual server startup and Socket.IO polling handshake

limits: No live browser interaction verified; prompt changes were source-reviewed and built.
No persistent-file restart test or migration on an existing user database.
No authenticated restaurant ownership, intake idempotency, durable outbox or paginated order history.
Existing-state checks do not establish multi-process optimistic concurrency; notification delivery remains best effort.
